title: TB SCREENING DRIVE on 5th and 6th October 2026 at KES Hans Bhugra High School

photo.alt: TB SCREENING DRIVE on 5th and 6th October 2026 at KES Hans Bhugra High School

summary: Following the TB Awareness Session conducted on 28th September 2026 by the BMC Health Team, a two-day TB screening drive was successfully conducted at KESHBHS, Kalina.
description:
Following the TB Awareness Session conducted on 28th September 2026 by the BMC Health Team, a two-day TB screening drive was successfully conducted at KESHBHS, Kalina.
Screening Details:
Screening was from 10:00 a.m. onwards with
a portable testing machine.
Total students screened: 165(Std. X-A, X-B & X-C)
Screening conducted by: BMC Health Team through preliminary symptom-based assessment.
Further action: 13 students showed presumptive TB symptoms and have been advised further investigation and medical consultation as per BMC protocol. Parents/guardians are being contacted individually and guided regarding the next steps.
Confidentiality: All student identities and health information are being kept strictly confidential. Results are shared only with concerned parents/guardians, the school head and authorised health professionals to prevent stigma and discrimination.
Acknowledgement & Vote of Thanks:
Rotary Club of Bombay Film City sincerely thanks Mr. Swapnil, Mr. Vijay and the entire BMC Health Team for their dedicated service and support. We also extend our heartfelt appreciation to the school management, teachers and staff of KESHBHS for their excellent cooperation and coordination.
Early detection, timely care – Together towards a healthy, TB-free Mumbai!
